title: Find the Distinct Difference Array
summary: Given an array nums of length n, compute the distinct difference array diff where diff[i] is the difference between the count of distinct elements in the suffix starting from i+1 to n-1 and the count of distinct elements in the prefix ending at i.
statement: Given an array nums of length n, compute the distinct difference array diff where diff[i] is the difference between the count of distinct elements in the suffix starting from i+1 to n-1 and the count of distinct elements in the prefix ending at i. Return the diff array.
constraints: For each index i, count distinct values in nums[0:i+1] and in nums[i+1:n].
Set answer[i] to prefix_distinct minus suffix_distinct.
Return all differences from left to right; the suffix after the final index is empty.
hints: Precompute the number of distinct values in every suffix, including the empty suffix.
Scan left to right with a set of values seen in the prefix.
After inserting nums[i], subtract suffix_distinct[i+1] from the prefix set size.
The two maintained counts exactly describe the disjoint index ranges required at every position.
editorial: The two maintained counts exactly describe the disjoint index ranges required at every position.

tests.explanation: Prefix distinct counts one through five minus suffix counts four through zero give -3, -1, 1, 3, and 5.
Repeated values affect only first appearances within each prefix or suffix set.
